dict.string: Nexus-AI needs Accessibility access to monitor the double-Control shortcut for activating the overlay and to capture selected text.
Nexus-AI uses Face ID to securely access your conversations and settings.
Nexus-AI needs screen capture to take screenshots and analyze screen content.
Nexus-AI uses the microphone for voice input.
Nexus-AI uses the camera for video input.
Nexus-AI uses Apple Events to work with Calendar, Reminders, and other native macOS apps on your behalf.
Nexus-AI reads your calendar so it can show events and create meetings for you.
Nexus-AI creates reminders and alarm-style tasks for you in Reminders.
